description: This file is a shell script designed for testing various functionalities of the 'git log' command, including formatting, filtering, decorations, graphs, signatures, and more. It contains numerous test cases to verify the behavior of 'git log' under different options and configurations.

methods.name: lib_test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Compares graphical log output with expected colorization and formatting.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, compares output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Utility function for grepping test output for expected patterns.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or tests git configuration variables.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new repository for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the test repository.

methods.name: test_decode_color
methods.description: Decodes color sequences from git log output.

methods.name: test_terminal
methods.description: Simulates a terminal environment for testing TTY output.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for required prerequisites, e.g., features.
